title: docs/bounded-web-transform.md is a session handoff report, including failing tests
description:
**Problem**
A published docs page is internal working-session text rather than documentation.

**Evidence**
- docs/bounded-web-transform.md:3 begins "Run from the Biblicus checkout with Python 3.10-3.13 ... The offline handoff was tested ..."
- docs/bounded-web-transform.md:32 reports failing tests as part of the handoff narrative.
- Related open epic: Provide Papyrus bounded web transformation handoff (dde6ae).

**Fix**
Rewrite the page as reference documentation (what the transform does, how to run it, its limits) and move handoff/status notes to the Kanbus issue.

**How to verify**
The page has no session-handoff language or test-failure narrative (`grep -n -i 'handoff\|failing' docs/bounded-web-transform.md` returns only intended product wording).

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
